newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR CLOSES AT DAY'S LOWS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR CLOSES AT DAY'S LOWS.

text.p: White sugar futures fell to the day's lows in late afternoon trading as a burst of liquidation and sell stops was prompted by a sell-off in New York futures.
The weak close could possibly see more selling building-up on Monday as chart patterns were breaking down, traders said.
By the close near October was trading at $320.10 a tonne, down $3.10 from Thursday and total turnover was 3,831 lots.
In Paris near Ocotber eased to $321.00 a tonne and turnover was 450 lots in the 45 ICUMSA contract. The 100 ICUMSA was tradeless.
